nv: jesus christ éí david bitsʼą́ą́dóó oochíiłii nilį́, áádóó david éí éíbraham bitsʼą́ą́dóó oochíiłii nilį́.

en: Thus, this is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ. Abraham for whom Isaac was born, and Isaac for whom Jacob was born, thereafter Jacob for whom Judah and his brothers were born,
nv: kótʼéego jesus christ bizází yę́ę náás daʼahílchį́. éíbraham éí áízak há yizhchį́, áádóó áízak éí jéíkab há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ jéíkab éí júdah áádóó bikʼisóó há niheezhchį́,

en: and next Tamar gave birth to Perez and Zerah for Judah, and after that Perez for whom Hezron was born, and after that Hezron for whom Ram was born,
nv: áádóó ákóneʼ téímar éí píírez índa zíírah, júdah bá jishchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ píírez éí hézran há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ hézran éí ram há yizhchį́,

en: and there Ram for whom Amminadab was born, and after that Amminadab for whom Nahshon was born, next Nahshon for whom Salmon was born,
nv: áádóó áadi ram éí amínadab há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ amínadab éí náshan há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ náshan éí sálman há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Salmon for whom Boaz was born by Rahab, Boaz for whom Obed was born by Ruth, and there Obed for whom Jesse was born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ réíhab éí bóʼaz, sálman bá jishchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ ruth éí óbed, bóʼaz bá jishchį́, áádóó áadi óbed éí jésii há yizhchį́,

en: there also Jesse for whom the great king David was born. And after that David for whom Solomon was born by Uriah’s wife,
nv: áadi índa jésii éí david aláahgo naatʼáanii há yizhchį́. áádóó bikʼijįʼ yoráíyah beʼasdzą́ą́ nítʼéʼígíí éí sálaman, david bá jishchį́,

en: and after that Solomon for whom Rehoboam was born, next Rehoboam for whom Abijah was born, and there Abijah for whom Asa was born,
nv: áádóó bikʼijįʼ sálaman éí riihobówam há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ riihobówam éí abáíjah há yizhchį́, áádóó áadi abáíjah éí éísa há yizhchį́,

en: and after that Asa for whom Jehoshaphat was born, then Jehoshaphat for whom Joram was born, and afterwards Joram for whom Uzziah was born,
nv: áádóó bikʼijįʼ éísa éí jiiháshafat há yizhchį́, ákóneʼ jiiháshafat éí jiihóram há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ jiihóram éí azáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: and there Uzziah for whom Jotham was born, and after that Jotham for whom Ahaz was born, and afterwards Ahaz for whom Hezekiah was born,
nv: áádóó áadi azáíyah éí jótham há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ jótham éí éíhaz há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ éíhaz éí heziikáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: and there Hezekiah for whom Manasseh was born, and after that Manasseh for whom Amon was born, and afterwards Amon for whom Josiah was born,
nv: áádóó áadi heziikáíyah éí manáseh há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ manáseh éí éíman há yizhchį́, áádóó nááʼákóneʼ éíman éí josáíyah há yizhchį́,

en: there also at the time of the deportation to Babylon Josiah for whom Jeconiah and his brothers were born.
nv: áadi índa bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ędą́ą́ʼ josáíyah éí jekonáíyah índa bikʼisóó há niheezhchį́.

en: And also after the deportation to Babylon Jeconiah for whom Shealtiel was born, there also Shealtiel for whom Zerubbabel was born,
nv: áádóó índa bábilangóó hoʼdisnááhdóó bikʼijįʼ jekonáíyah éí shiyáltiyel há yizhchį́, áadi índa shiyáltiyel éí zerábabel há yizhchį́,

en: and then Zerubbabel for whom Abihud was born, afterwards Abihud for whom Eliakim was born, and after that Eliakim for whom Azor was born,
nv: áádóó ákóneʼ zerábabel éí abáíyad há yizhchį́, nááʼákóneʼ abáíyad éí iiláíyakim há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ iiláíyakim éí éízor há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Azor for whom Zadok was born, and also Zadok for home Akim was born, and after that Akim for whom Eliud was born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ éízor éí zéídak há yizhchį́, áádóó índa zéídak éí éíkim há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ éíkim éí iiláíyad há yizhchį́,

en: afterwards Eliud for whom Eleazer was born, and after that Eleazer for whom Matthan was born, and Matthan for whom Jacob was again born,
nv: nááʼákóneʼ iiláíyad éí eliyéízer há yizhchį́, áádóó bikʼijįʼ eliyéízer éí máthan há yizhchį́, índa máthan éí jéíkab há náánázhchį́,

en: Jacob for whom Joseph was born, then Joseph became Mary’s husband. Mary gave birth to Jesus, who was called Christ.
nv: jéíkab éí jóseph há yizhchį́, áko jóseph éí mary bahastiin silį́į́ʼ. mary éí jesus, christ wolyéhígíí, jishchį́.

en: From when Abraham lived to when David lived are fourteen generations, and from when David live to the deportation to Babylon are fourteen generations, and from the deportation to Babylon to the birth of Christ are fourteen generations.
nv: áko éíbraham hiná yę́ędóó david hiná yę́ęjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́, áádóó david hiná yę́ędóó bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ęjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́, ákóneʼ bábilangóó hoʼdisnááh yę́ędóó christ yizhchį́įjįʼ dį́į́ʼtsʼáadahdi ałkʼi náʼázhchį́.

en: So, Jesus Christ was born this way. When his mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.
nv: jó, kótʼéego jesus christ hoʼdizhchį́. hamá mary éí jóseph yił ahaa dootʼashgo yił ahaʼdeetʼą́, nidi tʼah doo yił ahaítʼaashgóó, níłchʼi diyinii bibee adziilii bee izʼniiltsąądgo bééhoozin.

en: Then Joseph, her husband to be, since he was a righteous man, intended to divorce her privately to because he did not want to disgrace her.
nv: áko jóseph, hahastiin dooleełígíí, diné tʼáá ákogi átʼéii nilį́įgo, tʼáá nahonitʼinee nahjįʼ nihodideeshʼáałgo doo haa yáhodoosįįł da niizį́į́ʼ.

en: When he had contemplated this, and angel of the Lord appeared to him in a vision and said, Joseph, son of David, Do not fear taking Mary as your wife, because she is pregnant by means of the Holy Spirit.
nv: nidi díí yaa nitsíkees nítʼééʼ nayiiyeełgo bóhólníihii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí bichʼįʼ yitʼíní íʼdiilyaago ábíłní, jóseph, david biyeʼ nílíinii, mary neʼasdzą́ą́ yileehígíí tʼáadoo bikʼee nił yéʼí, háálá níłchʼi diyinii bibee adziilii bee izʼniiltsąąd.

en: The she will give birth to a boy, and you will call him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.
nv: áko ashkii yidoołchííł, áádóó jesus bee yídíízhiił, háálá bidineʼé bibąąhági ádaatʼéii yitsʼą́ąjįʼ yisdéidiyoonił.

en: This happened for the purpose of fullfilling what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet:
nv: diyin god yá halneʼii binahjįʼ bóhólníihii hahaasdzíiʼii ałtso bohodoolnííł biniyé ádzaa:

en: Behold, the virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Emmanuel, (which means Holy God with us).
nv: jóʼakon, chʼikę́ę́h tʼah doo diné bee haleehii awééʼ bee hodooleełgo ashkii yidoołchííł, éí imányowel bee yídóojiił, (éí diyin god nihił hólǫ́ jiníigo óolyé).

en: Joseph awoke from sleep, he did what the angel of the Lord said, he took Mary,
nv: nítʼééʼ jóseph tsʼéédzídzidgo nízhdiiʼnaʼ, áko bóhólníihii bidiyingo naalʼaʼí áhodííniidii biʼjiilaago, mary bił ahaa jítʼáázh,

en: but they did not have sexual relations until she gave birth to their son, and they named him Jesus.
nv: nidi tʼáadoo baa níjítʼįįhí biyáázh yishchį́, áádóó jesus bee jíízhiʼ.
